headword: {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}

definitions.explanation: The practice or process of correcting one's body posture, whether through exercises, devices, chiropractic treatment, or conscious habit changes.

examples.japanese: {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}ベルトを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a posture correction belt.

examples.japanese: {整体|せいたい}で{姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}をしてもらった。
examples.english: I had my posture corrected at a chiropractic clinic.

examples.japanese: デスクワークが{多|おお}い{人|ひと}は、{猫背|ねこぜ}になりやすいので、{日頃|ひごろ}から{姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}を{意識|いしき}することが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: People who do a lot of desk work tend to develop a hunched back, so it's important to be mindful of posture correction in daily life.

notes:
Compound of {姿勢|しせい} (posture) and {矯正|きょうせい} (correction; straightening). With the rise of desk jobs and smartphone use, {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい} has become a popular health topic in Japan. Products like posture belts, cushions, and {整体|せいたい} (chiropractic/bodywork) treatments are widely marketed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}ベルト: posture correction belt
- {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}クッション: posture correction cushion
- {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}ストレッチ: posture correction stretches
- {姿勢矯正|しせいきょうせい}{椅子|いす}: posture correction chair

RELATED TERMS:
- {猫背|ねこぜ}: hunched back, rounded shoulders
- {整体|せいたい}: chiropractic treatment, bodywork
- {骨盤矯正|こつばんきょうせい}: pelvic alignment correction
- {歯列矯正|しれつきょうせい}: orthodontics (same {矯正|きょうせい}, different domain)
